about: Corman Park No. 344 is a rural municipality surrounding the City of Saskatoon, Saskatchewan—not Saskatoon itself. Acreages, hamlets such as Grasswood, Casa Rio, and Furdale, and prairie around the South Saskatchewan River share the RM’s land. Martensville and Warman are neighbouring separate cities. About 9,000 people live in Corman Park.
